summary: P0.5 Amend Booking refund/payment scenarios - BOTH WORKING. Fixed 2 bugs during testing: (1) handleOpenAmend now calls fetchAvailableRoomsForAmend to load rooms on dialog open, (2) Changed room availability API from /dashboard/room-availability to /rooms/available with exclude_booking_id to include currently booked rooms.
